title: English Practice Quiz 0598
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: Use do + subject + base verb for present simple questions with you.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: I like tea, coffee and milk.
I like tea coffee and milk
I like, tea coffee, and milk.
i like tea, coffee and milk
questions.explanation: Use commas to separate items in a list and capitalise the first word.

questions.question: She arrived ___.
questions.explanation: Late is the correct adverb meaning not on time.

questions.question: A person you can trust is ___.
Which word has a different beginning sound?
questions.explanation: This begins with the voiced /ð/ sound; the others begin with the unvoiced /θ/ sound.

questions.question: If I had more time, I ___ another language.
questions.explanation: The second conditional uses would + base verb for an unreal or imagined situation.

questions.question: I ___ a new notebook yesterday.
questions.explanation: Yesterday signals the past simple. The past form of buy is bought.

questions.question: He wants to become ___ engineer.
questions.explanation: Engineer begins with a vowel sound, so use an.

questions.question: Read: 'Please keep the floor dry to prevent accidents.' What is the instruction?
questions.explanation: The notice instructs people to keep the floor dry.

questions.question: He said, 'I am tired.' Reported speech:
options: He said that he was tired.
questions.explanation: In standard backshift, am changes to was after a past reporting verb.
